name: dm-screen
description: Soft, offline-capable D&D 5e Dungeon Master screen with a built-in local oracle engine.

scripts.test: node test/runtests.mjs test/dice.test.mjs test/oracle.test.mjs test/sources.test.mjs test/providers.test.mjs test/auth.test.mjs test/backup.test.mjs test/bulk.test.mjs test/fivetools.test.mjs test/character.test.mjs
scripts.test:gate: npm run build && node test/bundle-server.mjs && (node server.built.mjs & sleep 3 && BASE=http://localhost:4180 node test/gate.test.mjs; kill %1)
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
